sql: SELECT c.remote_jid, c.contact_name, c.created_at, c.last_message_at, (SELECT last_check_at FROM provider_health h WHERE h.key = 'groups:' || w.id) AS ultima_busca FROM wapi_conversations c JOIN wapi_instances w ON w.id = c.instance_id WHERE w.managed_by_celebrei = true AND c.remote_jid LIKE '%@g.us' ORDER BY c.created_at
